sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 474 explicitly gives two series-level quantitative markers for the source-defined Zwangsneurose pattern: `Der Tendenzspannungsquotient ist sehr niedrig` with Σ0/Σ± `kleiner als 1`, and `% Sy.-R. größer als 50`. The page states that both are conditioned by the overnumber of ambivalent and null reactions. These lines are not preserved reliably as separate canonical units, so the admitted PDF governs the thresholds and formula typography.

Fall 40 provides a worked example rather than a new general threshold: 67.5% Symptomreaktionen and Tendenzspannungsquotient 0.9. Szondi explicitly explains the quotient below 1 by the sum of ambivalent reactions exceeding the sum of null reactions.

sourceExcerpt: Typisch ist für die Zwangsneurose auch der niedrige Tendenzspannungsquotient, der unter 1 steht (0,9), da ja die Summe der ambivalenten größer als die der Nullreaktionen ist.
romanianRendering: În rezumatul sindromatic al Zwangsneurose, Szondi indică un Tendenzspannungsquotient foarte scăzut, sub 1, și un procent al Symptomreaktionen peste 50; le leagă de predominanța reacțiilor ambivalente și nule. Fall 40 ilustrează această structură prin TspQu 0,9 și 67,5% Symptomreaktionen.
doctrinalStatement: În cadrul syndromatikii istorice a Zwangsneurose, sursa definește o constelație cantitativă de serie: `Tendenzspannungsquotient < 1` și `% Sy.-R. > 50`, explicate prin supraponderea reacțiilor ambivalente și nule. Fall 40 este un exemplu de aplicare (0,9; 67,5%), nu o sursă pentru noi praguri. Aceste două valori sunt fapte calculabile de serie, dar aici rămân P2A și nu devin singure criterii diagnostice.
conditions: Requires a profile series sufficient for the source-defined Tendenzspannungsquotient and prozentuale Symptomreaktionen calculations.
Use the printed-page thresholds exactly as source-era syndrome markers; do not substitute case-specific values for the general thresholds.
exceptions: Do not infer Zwangsneurose from TspQu < 1 alone.
Do not infer Zwangsneurose from % Sy.-R. > 50 alone.
Do not convert Fall 40 values 0.9 and 67.5% into universal thresholds.
scopeNotes: This record intentionally bridges already calculable P1 series quantities to a source-defined P2A syndrome statement without activating a P2B classifier.
The detailed factor-by-factor symptom distribution of Fall 40 remains case material.

relations.note: Adds series-level quantitative markers to the already represented vectorial isolation/vertical-splitting structure.

ambiguities: Canonical derivative U005379-U005392 omits or damages the page-474 quantitative formula lines; admitted PDF printed page 474 is authoritative for `< 1` and `> 50`.

P2A only; no runtime Zwang classifier or threshold activation is added.
